papers.title: A multiscale modeling approach for fast prediction of part distortion in selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Dept of Mechanical Engineering, The University of Alabama, Tuscaloosa, AL 35487, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Y. B. Guo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Dept of Mechanical Engineering, The University of Alabama, Tuscaloosa, AL 35487, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法与AM生物医用材料方向缺乏直接联系，未涉及多孔结构、力学测试或生物相容性。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure design, no LPBF fabricated biomedical implants, no mechanical or fatigue testing, and no surface roughness or osseointegration data.

summary_zh.motivation: 快速预测选区激光熔化零件变形
summary_zh.method: 建立多尺度模型模拟热-力学耦合过程
summary_zh.result: 实现了变形的高效预测
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真案例验证模型准确性

summary_en.motivation: To develop a computationally efficient multiscale model for predicting part distortion during selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A multiscale framework coupling thermal and mechanical simulations at different length scales was proposed.
summary_en.result: The model achieved fast and accurate distortion prediction compared to full-scale simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing predicted distortion with detailed finite element simulations.

papers.title: Midterm Outcome of Cementless Total Hip Arthroplasty in Crowe IV–Hartofilakidis Type III Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, First Affiliated Hospital of Xinjiang Medical University, Urumqi, Xinjiang, China

corresponding_authors.name: Li Cao
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, First Affiliated Hospital of Xinjiang Medical University, Urumqi, Xinjiang, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅报告发育性髋关节发育不良全髋关节置换术的临床结果，未涉及生物力学或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify femoral stress/strain, micromotion, or any finite element modeling; it is a clinical outcomes study without biomechanical analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估Crowe IV型髋关节发育不良全髋置换术的中期疗效。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析临床和影像学数据。
summary_zh.result: 假体生存率和功能评分可接受，但并发症发生率较高。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访和影像学评估。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the midterm clinical and radiographic outcomes of cementless total hip arthroplasty in patients with Crowe IV developmental dysplasia of the hip.
summary_en.method: A retrospective review of clinical and radiographic data, including Harris Hip Scores and implant survival analysis.
summary_en.result: Acceptable implant survival and functional improvement were observed, though complications such as dislocation and nerve palsy occurred.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up with radiographic assessment and Kaplan-Meier survival analysis.

papers.title: A critical analysis of radiographic factors in patients who develop dislocation after elective primary total hip arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Hospital for Special Surgery, 535 East 70th Street, New York, NY, 10021, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Marion Opperer
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Hospital for Special Surgery, 535 East 70th Street, New York, NY, 10021, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床回顾性研究，分析全髋关节置换术后脱位的影像学因素，未涉及生物力学建模、应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanical modeling, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no implant design or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 识别全髋关节置换术后脱位的影像学危险因素
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析术后X线片中的解剖和假体位置参数
summary_zh.result: 发现髋臼外展角过大等多项因素与脱位显著相关
summary_zh.validation: 基于231例患者的临床数据验证

summary_en.motivation: To identify radiographic factors predisposing to dislocation after primary total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective case-control study measuring acetabular and femoral component position on postoperative radiographs.
summary_en.result: Excessive acetabular abduction angle and combined anteversion were significantly associated with dislocation risk.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation using a cohort of 231 patients with dislocation and matched controls.
